ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the hexagon $ABCDEF$, each interior angle is equal. If $\angle 1=58^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle 2$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since all internal angles of the hexagon ABCDEF are equal, \\
$\therefore \angle B = \angle C = \angle CDE = (6-2) \times 180^\circ \div 6 = 120^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle$CDA $= 360^\circ - \angle1 - \angle B - \angle C = 62^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle2 = \angle CDE - \angle CDA = \boxed{58^\circ}$.
